senses.gloss:
रुरुक्षणि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. the Desid.), Ved. wish-
ing or able to destroy.

रुरुदिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid.), wishing or
intending to weep, inclined to cry.

रुरुत्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to obstruct or oppose;
wishing to bind or tie up (as the hair).

रुरु रुरु, उस्, m. (in Uṇādi-s. IV. 103.
said to be fr. rt. 1. रु), a kind of deer; a species of
rapacious animal, a dog; a species of fruit tree; N.
of a son of the Ṛṣi Pramati by the Apsaras Ghṛ-
tācī; of a divine being enumerated among the Viśve
Devāḥ; of one of the seven Ṛṣis under Manu
Sāvarṇi (his patronymic is Kāśyapa); of a Dānava
or Daitya (said to have been slain by Durgā); of a
form of Bhairava, (sometimes called रुरु-भैरव.)
—रुरु-मुण्ड, अस्, m., N. of a mountain, (also
read उरु-मुण्ड.)
—रुरु-शीर्षन्, आ, -ष्णी, अ,
Ved. ‘deer-headed,’ having a deer's horn or having
a destructive point (said of an arrow; Sāy. = शृङ्ग-
शीर्षन् or हन्तृ-शिरस्क).
रुरुक, अस्, m., N. of a king.
रूर रूर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. hot, burning.
